what: Paychex handles payroll and human resources for small and medium businesses. It processes pay, files payroll taxes, administers benefits and insurance, and since buying Paycor serves larger companies too, with about 840,000 customers.
customers: Small and medium-sized businesses across the United States and parts of Europe.
money: payroll processing, HR software and benefits administration
co-employment services and insurance for small firms
interest earned on payroll money held before it is paid out
moat: Payroll is the last thing a business changes supplier for, because errors mean unpaid staff and tax penalties, so retention is very high.
risks: Small business employment levels drive the number of employees it is paid to process
Falling interest rates reduce the income it earns on client money held
Integrating Paycor is a large undertaking
Analyst targets imply the shares are roughly fairly valued
opportunities: Revenue grew about 17% last year with a 39% operating margin
Return on invested capital of 23% with a dividend yield above 4%
Paycor extends it into the larger-company market where ADP has been strongest
watch: Client employee counts and revenue retention.
